newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne stake held by investor group.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne stake held by investor group.

text.p: An investor group including Elliott Associates and Westgate International LP said Tuesday it holds 7.81 percent stake in Envirodyne Industries Inc or 1,136,600 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 196,300 common shares bought between February 5 and March 6 at prices ranging from $6.50 to $6.88 per share.
Envirodyne, based in Oak Brook, Ill., manufactures cellulosic casings, shrinkable plastic bags, plastic packaging, films, plastic flatware, drinking straws and thermoformed plastic containers.
